versions.changelog: Added README.en.md (English counterpart of README.md) for English-speaking users. No skill behaviour change.

Review-driven hardening: added explicit scope/non-trigger boundaries and user-confirmation gates for high-impact steps (SQP-1); clarified NODE_OPTIONS='' is process-scoped not global and added confirmation requirement (RA2/TM1); declared background dsh web as user-controlled (persistence_privilege); removed all emoji, cleaned Chinese/English mixing, and replaced personal paths with placeholders.
Removed the Electron desktop-shell (optional) section and its reference file; that topic will live as a separate skill/project. Pure documentation cleanup, no behavioral changes.

Added 'Security and guardrails' section clarifying that NODE_OPTIONS='' only disables the sandbox injected safe-delete hook for the dsh web launch, and the forceful rmSync targets only one stale dsh cache symlink and touches no user data.

Initial release focused on deploying and troubleshooting DeepSeek Harness on Windows, especially within managed/WorkBuddy Node environments.

- Covers common pitfalls: safe-delete hook failures, pnpm/corepack path corruption, workspace-selection persistence, EPERM symlink issues, and launch commands.
- Provides verified commands for reliable DeepSeek Harness startup on Windows 10/11.
- Documents issues specific to WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy sandboxes vs. general Windows deployment.
- Includes compatibility notes for agent skills ecosystems (WorkBuddy, OpenClaw, etc.).
- Reference guides for full troubleshooting and desktop shell (Electron) packaging.
